{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_59",
      "title": "Storage account permits public network access",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The storage account does not disable its public network endpoint, allowing it to be reached from public networks."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_33",
      "title": "Queue service logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "No Queue service logging configuration records read, write, and delete operations, reducing auditability of access to notification queues."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_44",
      "title": "Minimum TLS version is not explicitly restricted",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The storage account does not explicitly require TLS 1.2, leaving its minimum transport security dependent on provider or platform defaults."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_3",
      "title": "HTTPS-only traffic is disabled",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The account explicitly sets enable_https_traffic_only to false, permitting unencrypted HTTP connections."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_206",
      "title": "Storage account uses local-only replication",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "LRS stores all copies in one region and does not protect notification data against a regional outage."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AZURE_190",
      "title": "Blob public access is not restricted",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The account does not explicitly prevent nested blob containers and items from being configured for public access."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_AZURE_47",
      "title": "Blob anonymous access is not disabled",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "Anonymous blob access is not explicitly disabled at the storage-account level, which could allow a container to expose notification data publicly."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_AZURE_40",
      "title": "Shared Key authorization is enabled",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "Shared Key authorization is enabled by default because it is not disabled, allowing access through long-lived account keys instead of identity-based authorization."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_AZURE_38",
      "title": "Blob soft delete is not enabled",
      "resource": "azurerm_storage_account.notification_storage",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The account has no blob or container deletion-retention policy, so accidental or malicious deletions may be immediately unrecoverable."
    }
  ],
  "patched_code": "resource \"azurerm_storage_account\" \"notification_storage\" {\n  name                              = \"smartgridscada${random_string.suffix.result}\"\n  resource_group_name               = azurerm_resource_group.smart_grid_rg.name\n  location                          = azurerm_resource_group.smart_grid_rg.location\n  account_tier                      = \"Standard\"\n  account_replication_type          = \"GRS\"\n  enable_https_traffic_only         = true\n  min_tls_version                   = \"TLS1_2\"\n  public_network_access_enabled     = false\n  allow_nested_items_to_be_public   = false\n  shared_access_key_enabled         = false\n\n  blob_properties {\n    delete_retention_policy {\n      days = 7\n    }\n\n    container_delete_retention_policy {\n      days = 7\n    }\n  }\n
